Project Assistant: Maximum age limit is 50 years. Age relaxation for women is 5 years, for SC/ST is 5 years, for OBC is 3 years, and for PWD is 10 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/ Biochemistry/ Chemistry/ Food chemistry/ Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agronomy/Genetics and Plant Breeding for Project Associate-I. B.Sc. in Agriculture/ Life Sciences or 3year Diploma in Engineering & Technology/ Computer/ Information technology for Project Assistant.
qualification.details: Project Associate-I: Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences/ Biochemistry/ Chemistry/ Food chemistry/ Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/ Agricultural Sciences/ Agronomy/Genetics and Plant Breeding. Proven hands-on experience in the computational analysis and interpretation of biological data, particularly NGS data and strong programming skills in Python, R, or Perl, with experience in scripting under Linux/UNIX environments. Experience in agriculture research for phenotyping, crop management & statistical analysis. Experience in analytical food chemistry. Publications in peer-reviewed high impact journals. Project Assistant: B.Sc. in Agriculture/ Life Sciences or 3year Diploma in Engineering & Technology/ Computer/ Information technology. Working experience in field experiment, data recording in germplasm collections for phenotyping and crop management & statistical analysis. Proficiency in computer operations (MS office).

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-I. Rs. 20,000+ 27% HRA for Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NBPGR recruitment is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Project Associate and Project Assistant positions at the National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: For the Project Assistant position, candidates need to have a B.Sc. in Agriculture/Life Sciences or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology/Computer/Information Technology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Project Associate-I will receive a salary of Rs. 31,000/- + 27% HRA or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted via email to the specified addresses. No other mode of application will be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NBPGR recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by a physical or online interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the NBPGR located?
faq.answer: The National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR) is located in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
